```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(MASS)
library(mgcv)
select <- dplyr::select; filter <- dplyr::filter
options(na.action = na.warn)
data("sim1", package = "modelr")
data("sim4", package = "modelr")
sim1_base <- sim1
```

## Task 1 — Inject Outliers and Fit Models

```{r robust-fit}
# TODO: Create sim1_out: add 15 to y for rows 3 and 17.

  mutate(
    y          = ifelse(row_number() %in% c(3, 17), y + 15, y),
    is_outlier = row_number() %in% c(3, 17)
  )
```
